newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-CRONJE NAMED CAPTAIN FOR FIVE SERIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CRONJE NAMED CAPTAIN FOR FIVE SERIES.

text.p: Hansie Cronje has been confirmed as South Africa captain for the next five series, totalling 16 tests.
The United Cricket Board of South Africa said on Monday that Cronje would be captain, with opener Gary Kirsten as his vice-captain, until the end of next year's five-test tour of England.
Before then Cronje will lead his team on tours of Pakistan and Australia and home series against Pakistan and Sri Lanka.
